## Use this catalog

Use this file when a request names a visual direction or needs a theme choice.
Pick one theme, then read its linked reference file. The fit notes describe
how closely a theme matches the eklipse Gravitational Press system. The notes do
not override the user request or the constraints in [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md).

Each link below points to one file in `themes/`. The package must keep the list
and the files in one-to-one agreement.

## Theme fit for eklipse

These themes are closer to the Gravitational Press system:

| Slug | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| `impeccable` | Editorial poster with cream and burnt orange |
| `editorial` | Magazine layout with serif type |
| `modern` | Contemporary editorial layout with a restrained palette |
| `basic` | Print-inspired editorial grid |
| `claude` | Research journal on warm ivory with dark slate ink |
| `refined` | Curated minimal layout with serif type |
| `dramatic` | Theatrical composition with strong contrast |
| `cosmic` | Dark science-fiction palette with spatial depth |
| `premium` | Precise and polished interface treatment |
| `artistic` | High-contrast expressive typography |
| `terracotta` | Clay tones with cream surfaces and serif display type |

These themes are further from the Gravitational Press system:

| Slug | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| `sega`, `pacman`, `tetris` | Arcade worlds |
| `lingo`, `fiction` | Children-oriented worlds |
| `material`, `ant`, `enterprise` | Web application and dashboard worlds |
| `roku`, `stitch`, `levels` | Web application and dashboard worlds |
| `agentic`, `corporate` | Web application and dashboard worlds |
| `professional`, `shadcn` | Developer-tool and business interface worlds |
| `codex`, `mono` | Developer-tool worlds |
| `neumorphism`, `claymorphism` | Soft three-dimensional surfaces |
| `skeumorphism`, `glassmorphism` | Soft three-dimensional surfaces |
| `perspective` | Three-dimensional depth that conflicts with the flat fields |
| `bento` | Card grids that conflict with the eklipse layout |
| `doodle`, `sketch`, `friendly` | Friendly and playful worlds |
| `vibrant`, `colorful`, `expressive` | Friendly and playful worlds |
| `creative`, `storytelling` | Playful story worlds |
| `immersive`, `cafe` | Worlds that weaken the rave editorial identity |

## Quick defaults

- eklipse site UI: use Gravitational Press in `DESIGN.md`. Use a catalog theme
  only when the user asks for one.
- Dashboard or hosted software app: use `clean`, `ant`, or dark `enterprise`.
- Marketing or landing page: use `modern`, `creative`, or `impeccable`.
- Developer tool: use `shadcn`, `mono`, or `codex`.
- Game or children-oriented product: use `sega`, `fiction`, or `lingo`.
- Blog, documentation, or long-form content: use `editorial`, `paper`, or
  `claude`.

## Package check

Check that every `themes/<slug>.md` file appears in this catalog and that each
catalog link resolves. Use the package link check before closing a change.
